about_the_game:
Pigeon’s Mission began as a sketchbook dream by Logan, his just 6 years old when he first drew Archie, Crazy Guy, and the rest of this imaginative cast. Now, those hand-drawn ideas have evolved into a rich, 2D pixel platformer filled with heart, humor, and high-flying (well… kind of) action.

Play as Archie Airborne, a grounded pigeon with a big heart, as you wall-jump, dash, and battle your way through dreamy worlds inspired by Logan’s original designs. Along the way, uncover heartfelt story beats, laugh-out-loud boss fights, and dazzling power-ups—all animated in loving, pixel-perfect detail.

🎮 Features

🌀 Skill-Based Gameplay

Built to be fun for kids and rewarding for seasoned platformer fans, every level encourages creative play, quick reactions, and smart use of your power-ups. Discover hidden paths, master tight jumps, and use every tool in your backpack to rise to the challenge.

🎯 Precision Platforming

Archie moves like a dream—snappy, responsive, and intuitive. From satisfying wall slides to combo attacks and midair dashes, you’ll feel in control from moment one. The deeper you play, the more Archie reveals what he’s truly capable of.

🌱 The Harvest Pulse System

At the heart of every encounter is the Harvest Pulse System. Collect Golden Seeds from enemies and the environment to fuel your Weapons and Tools. Each item charges differently and has unique effects—clearing enemies, exploring secret routes, or giving you a vital edge in boss fights. Choose wisely and adapt on the fly!

🌎 Explore 7 Whimsical Worlds

From grassy fields to space battles, each world is drawn from Logan’s original sketchbook and bursting with personality:

🌿 Hill Hopping – Your cozy intro to the adventure

🏜️ Dusty Dunes – Enemy waves and desert wind puzzles

🪨 Rocky Road – Heavy combat and hidden smash paths

🌊 Splashy Streams – Underwater puzzles and glowing ruins

🎪 Whacky Woods – Carnival chaos meets high-speed coasters

☁️ Heavenly Hike – Skyborn vertical combat and floating islands

🪐 Cosmic Craft – Final showdown in a high-tech alien lair

💥Power-Packed Upgrades

Archie unlocks a delightful arsenal of tools and weapons, including:

  • Winged Wonder – Rocket-powered glider flight

  • Pinecone Launcher – Explosive long-range pinecone blaster

  • DustBuster – Vacuum clears entire screens (but no seed drops!)

  • Rocky Hammer – Shattering ground pounds with stun effects

  • Hydro Helm – Breath and light underwater

  • Phoenix Feather – Adds a bonus life bar

  • Tech Mech – Massive power suit for the finale!

👹 Epic Boss Battles

Face off against over-the-top villains with wild mechanics and story depth:

🧀 Ray the Rat – Bomb-throwing cheese goblin of Hill Hopping

🐞 Big Bug – Digs, rolls, and drops from above

🪨 Rocky Ronster – Fire punches and rising lava puzzles

🌊 Whirlpool Wave – Water vortexes and monster summons

🎩 The Magnificent Marvo – Magic squirrel with illusions

🦅 Flam – Quill attacks, divebombs, and stormy skies

🧪 Crazy Guy – Goo-mutated final villain with 3 chaotic phases

Every boss has a backstory, a twist, and a kid-style flair that brings Logan’s world to life.

❓Frequently Asked Questions

Is there a demo?

🚀 Yes! A demo is in the works featuring the early levels of Hill Hopping, including the Pinecone Launcher and Harvest Pulse System. Wishlist now and be the first to know when it drops!

Who created the game?

🎨 Originally imagined by Logan when he was just 6 years old! He sketched out the characters, enemies, and worlds. His dad, a game dev and forever-kid-at-heart, helped bring it to life using GameMaker Studio 2.

How long is the game?

⏱️ 6–8 hours for the main story. Expect longer playtimes for 100% completionists collecting Game Pieces, unlocking Logan’s concept art, and revisiting earlier levels with new tools.

What is the Harvest Pulse System?

✨ It’s a power-management system that rewards exploration and smart combat. Golden Seeds fuel your tools and weapons—each with its own charge meter and tactical use. Manage your energy to fly, fight, or defend at just the right moment.

Is it kid-friendly?

👨‍👩‍👧 Yes! The game is designed with all-ages storytelling, gentle humor, and safe themes. But don’t be fooled—beneath the charm is a platformer that’ll challenge players who dig deeper.

Can I use a controller?

🎮 Absolutely. Full controller support, including Steam Deck, keyboard & mouse remapping, and future support for Nintendo Switch.

Will it run on my setup?

🖥️ It’s optimized for 60 FPS and lightweight enough for most modern PCs and laptops. 4K and ultrawide support included.

What platforms is it coming to?

🕹️ Launching first on Windows PC and macOS, with Nintendo Switch coming post-launch. Linux is being explored based on demand.

When is it coming out?

📅 2025! Wishlist it now and follow us on dev logs and social to stay in the loop. 💛

💌 6 Years in the Making

What started as bedtime drawings and doodles has become a full-fledged adventure. Pigeon’s Mission is a love letter to childhood creativity, pixel nostalgia, and the magic of making games together. Whether you’re a kid, a parent, or a platformer fan—this game is for you.

short_description: Soar into a pixel-rich platformer born from a 6-year-old’s imagination! Join Archie, a brave flightless pigeon, on a heartfelt quest to save his parents. Explore Pepper Pines, unlock quirky gadgets, and power up with the Harvest Pulse System in a whimsical platforming adventure.
